One other worker is very close—roughly an arm’s length ahead and to the right—facing the camera wearer and looking down toward the work area. Loose concrete blocks and the developing stack are within reach. The block moves into the space between them, and the worker reaches toward it, indicating an intended handoff. The worker is the recipient, not an obstacle in the wearer’s path, so the appropriate next action is to transfer the block securely.
